title: Measurement
description: One measurement record produced by the probe. Shared contract for probe, backend and dashboard. One row per (workload, endpoint) run.

ts.description: UTC timestamp of the measurement, ISO 8601.

site.description: Human deployment label, e.g. 'liverpool-eduroam-library'. Set via PROBE_SITE; groups results by network/location. Null when unset.

run_id.description: Groups the three endpoint runs of one scheduled heavy workload.

endpoint.description: Which endpoint family this run hit.

target.description: Concrete host or label the run measured.

ok.description: True if the run completed and produced valid metrics.

error.description: Error detail when ok is false.

metrics.description: Numeric results. Expected keys per workload (all optional so the schema stays stable): web -> dns_ms, connect_ms, ttfb_ms, load_ms; video -> startup_ms, rebuffer_count, rebuffer_ms, stream_mbps, bitrate_mbps, headroom_x (delivery rate / media bitrate; 1.0 means playback is on the edge of stalling), quality_tier (4K | 1080p | 720p | 480p | below-480p); email -> fetch_ms; download -> throughput_mbps, bytes; baseline -> dns_ms, rtt_ms, jitter_ms, loss_pct, tcp_mode (1 when RTT/loss came from TCP handshakes because the target drops ICMP); path -> hops, dest_rtt_ms, dest_loss_pct, worst_rtt_ms, first_hop_rtt_ms (WiFi-link latency), bottleneck_hop, bottleneck_delta_ms, isp_asn, dest_asn, and per hop hop_NN_rtt_ms / hop_NN_loss_pct plus identity labels hop_NN_host (rDNS), hop_NN_asn, hop_NN_org (operator name), hop_NN_role (home | isp-access | isp-core | transit | destination | unknown); loadlat -> idle_rtt_ms, loaded_rtt_ms, bloat_ms, loaded_rtt_max_ms, load_mbps.

context.description: Environment captured with every record so changes show up in the data.

ssid.description: Network name of the WiFi under test.

bssid.description: MAC of the associated AP; distinguishes same-SSID networks (e.g. eduroam) across locations.

raw_ref.description: Blob Storage key for a large raw payload (e.g. full traceroute JSON). Null when there is none.

net_hash.description: Truncated + hashed public IP (ethics: site is not identifiable from stored data).
